task.title: Run a migration
task.shortdesc: Start a run for one DITA map from the Maps screen, in one of three modes.

ul.li: migrate: applies approved rules only. No model is called.
replay: replays a recorded agent session. The tools and checks run for real; only the model's words are fixed.
live: the agent calls for each failing topic.

step.cmd: On the map's row, choose a mode.

stepresult.p: The run is queued. If another run is queued or running, wait for it to finish.
